title: Hymn index prints hour 'L' for two hymns that the body gives to the Office of Readings: re-code them?
prompt:
The Index hymnorum (p1219) prints hour L (Lauds) for two hymns that the body of the book prints at Off. lect., not at Lauds:
- #175 'Iste quem læti' (LHym 357), 19/3 L: p743 'Off. lect. H Iste quem læti colimus (LHym 357)'; Lauds on p744 is 'Cælitum Ioseph (LHym 358)', which already holds st-joseph LAUDS.hymn option 1 (gregobase:11972).
- #186 'Magdalæ sidus' (LHym 399), 22/7 L V: p816 'Off. lect. H Magdalæ sidus (LHym 399)' and 'Laudes H Aurora surgit lucida (LHym 398)' (already holds mary-magdalene LAUDS.hymn option 1, gregobase:10456); p819 Vesp. H Magdalæ sidus (OCO VESPERS row is already loaded).
No 'Vel:' or 'Alia melodia' rubric on either page, so neither is a Lauds alternative. Neither feast has an OCO OFFREAD.hymn row yet (only LIBER_HYMNARIUS rows). Same class as #25 (index day misprint, re-coded from the body).
